description: Is a company taking more of its sector's money than usual: its share of its sector's dollar volume over the latest session or the last 5 or 20, against its usual share (the median of its last comparable sessions, up to 40, before the window), and the sector's own × normal, in sentences. One company, in a market whose sector shares InfinityVolume publishes. No prices or price changes.

market.description: Market key or name, e.g. US or Japan. Leave out to find the company in any of the 13 markets.

ticker.description: A ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, Lumentum or 7203.T. A market may lead it, as Japan:7203.T.

window.description: Sessions: 1, 5 or 20 (or a week or a month). Default 1 (the latest session).

name: infinity_company_vs_sector
title: Company versus its sector
